entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Please say 'Sales', 'Support', or 'Returns' to be connected.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. My name is Isaac, my agent ID is 301. How can I help you today?
I need to return an item. Order number is VF-8821-95B.

Certainly, let me just pull that up for you... Okay, I see the order for the Sonic Pro cycling shoes. I can definitely look into this. Can I ask, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference matter?
They don't fit. I took them for one ride and got terrible blisters. I just want a refund.
I'm very sorry to hear that; that's certainly not the experience we want for our customers. Getting blisters is a definite deal-breaker. Let me just confirm the return eligibility for you.
Just tell me yes or no.
Yes, absolutely. Your order was delivered eight days ago, which is well within our 90-day policy for a full refund. I've just initiated that for you.

I've sent a pre-paid return label to the email on file. Please make sure you've removed any personal cleats you may have installed, then pack the shoes in the original box and attach the label. Once our warehouse receives the item, your refund will be issued.

And before you go, I see you're a VIP member with VeloFit. To apologize for the trouble with the fit, I've added a complimentary $25 credit to your account for a future purchase. We want to make sure we get you into the right gear next time.
Oh. Okay, that's good. Thank you.
You're most welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great rest of your day.
